term_rules.label: Appeal to the Tax Appeals Commission
term_rules.basis: Section 949I Taxes Consolidation Act 1997: an appeal is made by notice to the Tax Appeals Commission within 30 days after the date of the notice of assessment.
term_rules.notes: Late appeals are accepted only for a reasonable cause (section 949O). The tax return for the year must be filed before an appeal is valid.

term_rules.label: Cancellation period
term_rules.basis: Consumer Rights Act 2022, Part 4 (implementing Directive 2011/83/EU): 14 days from the day the consumer takes physical possession of the goods. Regulation (EEC) 1182/71: a period ending on a weekend or public holiday runs to the next working day.
term_rules.notes: v_purchase_rights counts from the order mail when there is no delivery mail, which errs early. Without proper cancellation information the period extends by up to 12 months.

term_rules.label: Short-term right to terminate
term_rules.basis: Consumer Rights Act 2022, Part 2: a consumer may reject goods that do not conform to the contract and get a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
term_rules.notes: Perishable goods have a shorter period. After that, repair or replacement and then a price reduction or final termination remain; the trader is liable for a lack of conformity that appears within six years of delivery.

term_rules.label: Tenant's notice of termination
term_rules.basis: Section 66 Residential Tenancies Act 2004: a tenant gives at least 28 days' notice for a tenancy of less than six months; longer tenancies need longer notice (35 days to 112 days by duration).
term_rules.notes: event_date is the day the notice is served. This counts the shortest period; set the real one from the tenancy's length. A fixed-term tenancy can only be ended early for a breach or by agreement.

annual_dates.label: File the Form 11 income tax return
annual_dates.basis: Section 959I Taxes Consolidation Act 1997: chargeable persons file the return for a tax year by 31 October of the following year.
annual_dates.notes: Filing and paying through ROS extends the date each year, usually to mid-November. PAYE-only employees are not chargeable persons and need not file unless they have other income.

facts.text: A TV licence is required for any television set at the address and is renewed every year. It is not cancelled automatically when you move.
Local Property Tax is due on residential property owned on the valuation date (1 November). Revenue sets the payment schedule; it can be paid by deduction at source, direct debit or in one sum.
